# convex_project (Resource)

Manages a Convex project within a team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "convex_team_id" {
  type        = number
  description = "Numeric team ID, shown in the Convex dashboard under team settings."
}

resource "convex_project" "minimal" {
  team_id = var.convex_team_id
  name    = "Minimal Project"
}

# Convex derives the slug from the name; set it explicitly to pin the
# dashboard URL.
resource "convex_project" "app" {
  team_id = var.convex_team_id
  name    = "My Application"
  slug    = "my-application"
}

# Creating a project does not create a deployment -- declare one separately.
resource "convex_deployment" "app_prod" {
  project_id      = convex_project.app.id
  deployment_type = "prod"
  is_default      = true
}

output "app_prod_url" {
  value = convex_deployment.app_prod.deployment_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full name of the project as it appears in the dashboard. Spaces and punctuation are allowed.
- `team_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the team that owns the project. Changing this forces a new project, since Convex cannot move a project between teams.

### Optional

- `slug` (String) Short name used in Convex dashboard URLs. Generated from `name` when not set. Note that Convex assigns the slug at creation time, so setting this on a new project results in a second API call to rename it.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (Number) Creation timestamp, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
- `dev_deployment_name` (String) Name of the requesting member's default development deployment for this project, if one exists.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the project.
- `prod_deployment_name` (String) Name of the project's default production deployment, if one exists (for example `happy-otter-123`).
- `team_slug` (String) Slug of the team that owns the project.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Projects are imported by their numeric ID, which you can find with the
# Management API: GET https://api.convex.dev/v1/teams/{team_id}/projects
terraform import convex_project.app 12345
```
